items.prompt: One single continuous shot beside an early-spring Hokkaido country road: gloved hands in navy sleeves give the clamp of a new bear warning sign a final turn with a spanner and let go; the camera slowly pulls back and pans to reveal a second new sign further along the empty road and the bare forested hills. Only hands and forearms ever appear, no face visible. No cuts, no scene change. No snow anywhere. 8 seconds. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style.
